title: Teachers, vibrato tone, saxophone sections, and New Orleans bands and musicians
summary: Rouzan discusses his teachers (his brother, Cottrell, Tio, David Jones), vibrato and tone, tuning, Handy and Sam Lee, then his bands and associates and the street bands of the quarter.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
